answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be enforced by requiring each identity to post a non-linear margin haircut escrowed against a violet-tagged collateral lock, so that duplicate registrations from one operator collapse onto a shared mirror ledger entry. Honest agents accumulate reputation through an orchard of verified order-flow histories, while colluders cannot. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
